Thread: Reference checks for Imogen Clarke — scheduling, runbook & capture

All three calls completed. Quick capture below (full notes in attached imogen_ref_notes.md and in the shared doc).

Liam Ortega (manager) — 11/21 10:00
- Strengths: clear ownership of infra migrations, communicates well with PMs.
- Development area: needs to push back earlier on scope creep.
- Score: 4/5

Zara Okoye (mentor) — 11/21 14:00
- Strengths: system-design intuition, cares about testability and monitoring.
- Development area: sometimes optimistic on timelines.
- Score: 4/5

Noor Bhatia (peer) — 11/22 09:30
- Strengths: strong collaborator on on-call rotations and runbooks.
- Development area: prefers asynchronous over real-time escalation (fit depends on team style).
- Score: 3/5

Overall recommendation: Hire — fits the team (mechanical excellence + solid infra judgment). Suggested mentoring plan: 1) clear handoff checklist for infra launches, 2) quarterly alignment on SLIs with PM.

Next steps: Ava will publish a 1-paragraph summary to HubSpot HS-78234 and attach the runbook notes; Recruiting will move the candidate to offer packet stage if leadership signs off.

Monica
Senior Recruiter
Redwood Inference
